text.p: Purus Inc said Tuesday it has cancelled a proposed $3.00 a share cash distribution to common shareholders and postponed its 1996 annual shareholders' meeting.

The company said in a statement the move was to allow newly appointed members of its board time to reexamine the merits of the distribution, which was subject to stockholder ratification at the annual meeting.

Purus also said that plaintiffs who filed a class action lawsuit in July 1995 and sought a motion for a preliminary injunction to freeze the company's assets in light of the proposed distribution have withdrawn their motion in light of the postponement and cancellation of the distribution.
Purus said it can give no assurances that the distribution will be proposed again at the rescheduled annual meeting, which will now take place no later than February 1997.
Last week Russell Burbank resigned as charirman, president and chief executive officer. A replacement has not yet been named.
